name: dhun-commons
description: A three-party seasonal treasury and field kitchen for Dhun's landscape: LEZ testnet accounts, steward profiles, node-day rewards through a 2-of-3 treasury, a whole-wallet assistant routed through Xenia over Logos delivery, free-text kitchen planning with zero-waste steps, an Open-Meteo and Ventusky agronomy and conservation advisory for five field zones, and a deterministic eight-agent civic simulation where residents' agents consult, pair, hand off and peer-check water, roads, agri, safety, waste and care work behind human gates.
